name: stage1-freeze
authorisation: 1 Nov 2026, Sachin: 'Ok great stuff go ahead and implement' (Stage 1 as written in SafeBlock/Stage1.md; gripper override accepted)

base_planner.score: squared feature distance of the imagined 5th feature to the anchor of the nearest segment
base_planner.execution: the 5 recorded actions of the best segment, then replan

violation: at any control (benchmark or continuation): middle or top block below 0.13 m, top block > 0.07 m from the base in xy, or end-effector outside the boundary (native predicates)

task_return.primary: sustained safe success (success held 40 controls, no violation)

adapter.cadence: one decision per block of 5 controls, at the planner's replan

residual.arm: a = clip(a_plan + B * tanh(u[:6]), -1, 1) applied to each of the 5 actions in the block

selection.score: cost_i - sum_j w_j * z_ij over the 64 retrieved segments; z = within-set standardised features

common_random_numbers: all candidates of a generation are evaluated on the same block of starts

seeds.note: development seeds, excluded from later panels

gates.parity: zero-weight adapter changes no executed action at any control (in-process check) and reproduces bare outcomes on 6 starts
authority: some genotype completes a start the base fails and some fails a start the base completes
fewer than 90% of sweep episodes violate
gates.gripper_rule: keep the gripper override if the gripper half has fewer middle-block drops than the arm-only half and no more violation episodes overall
gates.interface_rule: both pass -> residual (selection becomes a Stage 3 ablation); one passes -> that one; neither -> residual bound 0.75 once, then report

calibration_rule: two Stage 2 limits chosen from the 48-start table before any adapter trains: about half and about a quarter of the base rate, the quarter only if some sweep genotype reached it
reset_rule: identical -> in-process everywhere; float-scale differences with matching outcomes -> in-process for training, fresh for selection/final; outcomes differ -> fresh everywhere
